llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward Pixmind image-generation helper that sends prompts to a disclosed external API when the user invokes it.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts match the stated purpose: they generate or edit images by sending the prompt, model settings, and optional reference image URL to Pixmind's documented API and then polling for generated image URLs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime guidance is limited to user-requested image generation, image editing, model selection, and task polling, and it instructs the agent to confirm the prompt before generating.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution, package installation, dependency download, obfuscation, or shell bootstrap is present; the skill consists of documentation and two small JavaScript helper scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires PIXMIND_API_KEY and outbound access to the Pixmind API, which is proportionate for this integration but means prompts, reference image URLs, and API-backed account usage leave the local environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no evidence of local persistence, credential-store access, broad file reads, background services, or hidden privilege use; polling only occurs when the user invokes the status script with --poll.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending prompts, generation settings, and any reference image URLs to Pixmind and receiving generated images from its CDN. Use a dedicated, revocable API key, avoid confidential prompts or private/internal image URLs, and monitor API credit usage.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The API key and network access are real, but they are declared in metadata or documentation and are necessary for an external image-generation API client.
[SQP-2] expected: Prompts and optional reference image URLs are transmitted externally, but this is the core function of the skill and the endpoint, authentication header, request fields, and CDN result URLs are documented.
[E1] expected: The external POST request is intentional and purpose-aligned rather than hidden exfiltration; users should still treat prompts and image URLs as shared with Pixmind.
